name: Zephyrus Wing Energies Ltd
summary: Zephyrus Wing Energies Ltd. engages in renewable energy business in Poland. The company generates electricity from wind and photovoltaic farms. It also engages in the development, leasing activity, and construction of wind and photovoltaic farms; and engineering, procurement, construction, and technical and commercial management services. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel. As of April 23, 2026, Zephyrus Wing Energies Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Doral Group Renewable Energy Resources Ltd.
